text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — candidate for SRE role might be ~10 min late for the 3:00pm PT slot. Can we confirm scribe + recording consent? Zoom room: Redwood-SRE-Interview. @Priya can you cover scribe if needed?

Priya: I can scribe if needed. Does the candidate consent to recording? I thought they answered yes on the intake form but calendar doesn't show a note.

People Ops Bot: Calendar note missing. Candidate recording consent: "Yes" per intake form. Adding event note now.

Calendar Bot: Event updated — Recording consent: yes (intake). ✅

Jordan: I can host and enable recording when they join. If the candidate asks us to stop, we'll pause immediately. @Samir are you available to backfill scribe if Priya needs a break?

Samir: Happy to backfill or take the second half if needed. :thumbsup:

Aisha: Quick rubric question — for this requisition, system design weight is 25% and collaboration 15%, correct? I only have the generic SRE rubric in Confluence.

People Ops Bot: Confirmed rubric weights for SRE II: Technical 60, System design 25, Collaboration/communication 15. Use the SRE-II-interview template (Confluence). Anchor scores to the sample prompts in the doc. Link: https://confluence/redwood/sre-ii-interviews

Maya: Thanks. Priya — quick scribe runbook (paste):
```
Scribe checklist:
- Open shared doc: /docs/scribe-sre-II
- Note start time + timestamps for each question (e.g., 00:00, 06:45, 13:10)
- Short summary (1-2 lines) per answer + strength/weakness
- Flag any "red flags" in the Red Flags section
- Add recording link and timestamp reference after session
```

Priya: Got it — I'll create the shared notes and start them 5 minutes early, then ping here when the candidate joins.

Jordan: I'll enable the recording when candidate joins and paste the recording link in the notes.

People Ops Bot: Reminder set: 5 minutes before -> @Maya @Priya @Jordan.

Maya: One more logistic: if candidate is >15 minutes late we'll auto-switch to the backup candidate slot and not hold the panel beyond that. I'll add that contingency note to the calendar. Thanks everyone. :handshake:

Priya: Sounds good — I'll be on standby and will post the notes link shortly.

Samir: Thanks — will keep phone on in case Priya needs a quick hand.

Maya: I'll ping 5-min warning and again at start time. Appreciate the quick cover.
